documents.START-HERE.md:
# Start here

Open this vault as a local folder in Codex or Claude Code and as a vault in Obsidian. Review the folder hooks in the application. Capture and cloud summarization remain off until explicitly enabled. Normal web chats are not automatically collected.

Use separate conversations for separate work. Shared memory keeps source quotations; generated summaries are unverified.

To change language, run `python 00-System/Scripts/localization.py --ui en` from this vault. Use `--ui tr` for Turkish; `--conversation auto|en|tr` and `--summary en|tr` are independent settings. Edited starter pages are protected. Existing personal notes and quotations are never translated. The repository README explains setup and privacy.
